from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference-2/play/users/u041/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda c: sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy,xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy,xx))
                        q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in cells), max(y for y,x in cells)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in cells), max(x for y,x in cells)
            if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
                continue
            perimeter = {(y,x) for y in range(r0,r1+1) for x in range(c0,c1+1)
                         if y in (r0,r1) or x in (c0,c1)}
            if set(cells) != perimeter:
                continue
            fill = 7 if (r1-r0+1) % 2 else 2
            for y in range(r0+1,r1):
                for x in range(c0+1,c1):
                    out[y][x] = fill
    return out
'''
path=program_dir/'task-8535d71a.py'
path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(path),'exec'),globals())
print(path, path.exists())
